relationships.subject: 2-hydroxylated estrone (2-OHE1)
relationships.evidence_quote: 2- and 4-OHE1 activated the recombinant TRPA1 channel with EC50 values of 0.97 ± 0.10 μM and 1.07 ± 0.09 μM, respectively

relationships.subject: 4-hydroxylated estrone (4-OHE1)
relationships.evidence_quote: 10 μM 2- and 4-OHE1 evoked measurable membrane currents in HEK293T cells transfected with TRPV1 but not TRPV2, TRPV3, TRPV4, and TRPM8 channels

relationships.subject: 2-hydroxylated estrone (2-OHE1)
relationships.evidence_quote: preapplication and coapplication of 10 to 100 pM 2- and 4-OHE1 but not E1 or 16-OHE1 (which were ineffective even at 1 μM) concentration-dependently increased [Ca2+]i responses elicited by 5 μM AITC

relationships.subject: TRPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting that TRPA1 but not TRPV1 was required for pain-related responses in this mouse model of uterine pain

key_findings: 2- and 4-hydroxylated estrogen metabolites, not estrogen itself, activate TRPA1 and TRPV1 in DRG neurons and sensitize TRPA1 at picomolar concentrations.
TRPA1, but not TRPV1, is required for estrogen-induced uterine pain-like behaviors in mice.
